body: This PR fixes the library issues in the MPI tests and updates them to work with the recent datalayouts refactor. The newer climacommon uses julia 1.12 which loads its binary libcurl.so.4on startup. The manifest uses 1.10 and pins HDF5_jll, which expects a symbol version tag CURL_4 , but the binary provides CURL_OPENSSL_4 so it errors.
title: Fix failing MPI tests
